The '''Jagged Plains Imperial Garrison''' was an outpost in the [[Clabburn Tundra]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] operated by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Named for the [[Jagged Plains]], the garrison was actually located north of the Jagged Plains, in the [[Buried Field]] and just south of the [[Crescent Canyon]].
